integrity: Analytic proof reconstructed from elementary inequalities and the cited partial-transpose formula; packaged finite verifier is supportive, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to ideal controlled-shift conversion from pure qudit input followed by global depolarization; measures NPT survival, not separability/PPT-bound entanglement or independent local channels. Closest preprint inspected in indexed full-text excerpts; priority uncertainty remains.
title: Sharp diagonal-purity frontier for depolarization-resistant qudit entanglement
